definitions: A common name for a pet, often a cat or dog, especially one with dark fur.
A character in the Pac-Man video game series, one of the four ghost enemies.
A nickname for someone with dark hair or complexion, or someone associated with ink (e.g., a tattoo artist, a writer).
examples: Inky the cat curled up on the sofa.
Pac-Man was chased by Blinky, Pinky, Inky, and Clyde.
Inky always had smudges on his fingers from drawing.
